title: Finite Address Set for a Run
statement: For any program, natural number $n$, and configurations $c,c'$, if $n$ steps take $c$ to $c'$, then there is a finite set $K$ of memory addresses with $|K|\le 3n$ such that the same $n$-step run from $c$ to $c'$ touches only addresses in $K$.
hypotheses_covered: There are $n$ steps of the program from $c$ to $c'$
